metadata.description: Genuine live capture: cloning a persistent hand-created baseline (test_baseline_sdk in the readonly_fixtures organization group) INTO a disposable organization group via the clone request body's rootLocationGroupID -- confirmed cross-OG (the clone lands under the target OG, not the source), never mutating the source baseline or its OG.
